name: orc-cache
description: Prompt-cache meter for the hcorc/herdorc orchestrators: cache read share and countdown above the prompt, the ODD phase, a guard against waits that outlast the cache, and a checkpoint hint when the context grows large.

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto follows Claude Code's rules (FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M, CLAUDE_CODE_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL, the promptCacheTtl setting, ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H), then what request timing shows, then the account default (1 hour on a subscription, 5 minutes otherwise); 5m or 1h pins it

waitGuard.title: Waits longer than the cache
waitGuard.description: What to do when the orchestrator starts an hc/herdr wait that can last longer than the cache lifetime: deny tells the model to rerun it with a shorter --timeout, warn only shows a toast, off does nothing

checkpointAtTokens.title: Checkpoint hint (tokens)
checkpointAtTokens.description: From this prompt size up, the band suggests saving a checkpoint and clearing the conversation at the next clean point

everywhere.title: Show outside the orchestrators
everywhere.description: Also show the cache band in sessions that are not hcorc or herdorc
